$comment: Registry of managed apps. platforms: web | windows | macos | android | linux | docker. downloads: optional explicit list of {platform, label, asset regex | href} for apps with several downloads per OS (Arkeep). upstream: the repo a fork tracks. assets: optional per-platform regex overrides for matching release asset filenames. private: true for a private repo (the downloads page skips the release lookup and the source link). status: hidden keeps an app off the downloads page (internal tools with nothing to download).

projects.name: Nexus SSH
projects.description: A modern SSH terminal client with an encrypted vault you own: tabbed terminal, SFTP browser, key manager and file-based sync.

projects.name: My Million Dollar Grid
projects.description: Track your journey to $1,000,000: every $1,000 you earn fills one square of a 1,000-square grid you can share.

projects.name: World Explorer
projects.description: An Android app that fogs the world map and burns it away as you walk, cycle or drive, tracking how much of the planet you've explored.

projects.name: ProjectTrucks
projects.description: A local Euro Truck Simulator 2 delivery tracker for Windows: log every job and kilometre to a private SQLite database on your own machine.

projects.name: ProjectTrucks Hub
projects.description: The online side of ProjectTrucks: linked apps sync your ETS2 jobs here. Driver profiles, a live feed, virtual trucking companies and leaderboards.

projects.name: Finance Dashboard
projects.description: A local-first personal finance dashboard: transactions, CSV import from any bank, multi-currency FX, burn rate, recurring payments and transfer matching. Your data never leaves your machine.

projects.name: Obsidian Resource Pack Hosting
projects.description: Free Minecraft resource pack hosting by Obsidian Servers: upload a pack, get a direct download link and SHA1 hash for server.properties. No account needed.

projects.name: GroundStation
projects.description: Basecamp-style project management: message boards, to-dos, schedules, docs, chat, card tables, hill charts, check-ins and scorecards, with an MCP server so AI assistants can work alongside your team.

projects.name: Clerq
projects.description: An open-source, self-hostable business OS for developer-freelancers and small dev studios: clients, projects, time tracking, expenses and invoicing in one connected flow.

projects.name: PunterDigital Panel
projects.description: PunterDigital contractor platform: vetting, client directory, hire requests, engagements, e-signed contracts and timesheets, with invoicing through Clerq.

projects.name: AniTrack
projects.description: Track the anime you watch, plan what's next and discover something new: a full AniList-synced catalogue, seasonal charts, airing schedule, MAL import and a public API.

projects.name: Arkeep
projects.description: Self-hosted backups for all your servers on Restic and Rclone: one server with a web dashboard and a small agent on each machine. PunterDigital's patched build of the open-source Arkeep.
